name: select_all_selects_each_unlocked_top_level_object_once
note: actions.yaml select_all: `doc.op: {op: select_all}` selects every visible, unlocked direct child of a layer, a group as one object: here the cyan rect and the Mixed Group, never the locked layer's contents, the locked rect or the Locked Group. Not an undo step. Expected bytes from the engine's native table before the YAML route existed; the Mac reproduces them independently.

name: unlock_all_clears_every_lock
note: actions.yaml unlock_all: `doc.op: {op: unlock_all}` clears the flag on every element at every depth, a layer's own included, and keeps the selection (UNLOCKSEL). Expected bytes from the engine's native table before the YAML route existed; the Mac reproduces them independently.

name: hide_selection_hides_and_clears_the_selection
note: actions.yaml hide_selection: `doc.op: {op: hide_selection}` sets each selected element invisible and clears the selection.

name: show_all_reveals_and_selects_what_it_showed
note: actions.yaml show_all: `doc.op: {op: show_all}` makes every invisible element visible and selects exactly those (here both rects, hidden by the step before).

name: lock_locks_the_selection_and_clears_it
note: actions.yaml lock: `doc.op: {op: lock_selection}` locks each selected element and clears the selection. Expected bytes from the engine's native table before the YAML route existed; the Mac reproduces them independently.

name: group_wraps_the_selection_in_one_group
note: actions.yaml group: `doc.op: {op: group_selection}` wraps the selected siblings in one new group, selected. Expected bytes from the engine's native table before the YAML route existed; the Mac reproduces them independently.

name: ungroup_replaces_the_group_with_its_members
note: actions.yaml ungroup: `doc.op: {op: ungroup_selection}` replaces each selected group with its members, selected. Expected bytes from the engine's native table before the YAML route existed; the Mac reproduces them independently.

name: ungroup_all_flattens_every_unlocked_group
note: actions.yaml ungroup_all: `doc.op: {op: ungroup_all}` flattens every group that is not locked, by its own flag or by an ancestor's: the Mixed Group dissolves, the Locked Group and the locked layer's Inner Group stay. Expected bytes from the engine's native table before the YAML route existed; the Mac reproduces them independently.
